Salsa & SalsaDespicable Me 2Gru makes jelly now. Mostly.Every recipe serves 4.
    From the CounterPlatesThe Cake CaseCups and Shakes
    From the CounterSalsa and Salsa nachosCorn chips, beans, cheddar, salsa and avocado. Guac from a chip hat optionalHow to make it2 bags of corn chips1 can black beans250g cheddar1 jar jalapenos2 avocados1 jar tomato salsa300ml sour creamDrain the beans, grate the cheddar and slice the jalapenos. Smash the avocado.Layer the chips on a tray with beans, cheese and jalapenos.Bake at 200°C until melted.Top with salsa, avocado and sour cream.Agnes's fairy princess star fairy breadWhite slices buttered to the edges and pressed into hundreds and thousands, for the birthday partyHow to make itNot on tonight's cookSoft white bread spread with butter and pressed into hundreds and thousands, cut into stars with a cutter and piled high for the party.Soften 100g butter until very spreadable.Spread it right to the edges of 12 slices soft white bread.Tip 1 jar hundreds and thousands onto a plate and press each slice butter side down into them so the top is fully coated.Cut out stars with a large star cutter, or cut into triangles with the crusts off.Pile onto a platter and serve straight away so the colours don't run.PlatesEduardo's chicken enchiladasShredded chicken enchiladas. Not Pollito. He had a rough nightHow to make it800g chicken thighs4 dried chillies1 can crushed tomatoes8 flour tortillas200g cheddar300ml sour creamToast the chillies in a dry pan, soak in hot water, then blend with the tomatoes.Simmer the chicken in the sauce, then shred it.Roll the chicken in tortillas and place in a dish.Cover with more sauce and grated cheddar.Bake at 190°C.Serve with sour cream.Gru's lab spaghetti and meatballsBeef and pork balls simmered in tomato sauce over pasta, for Margo, Edith and AgnesHow to make itNot on tonight's cookSpaghetti and beef meatballs simmered 40 minutes in tomato sauce, a big pot for the whole household.Mix 300g beef mince and 300g pork mince with 1 egg, 40g breadcrumbs, 30g grated parmesan, 2 crushed garlic cloves and salt.Roll into 20 meatballs and brown in olive oil.Soften 1 diced onion, add 2 tins crushed tomatoes, a pinch of sugar and a handful of basil and simmer 15 minutes.Add the meatballs, cover and simmer 40 minutes.Toss with 500g cooked spaghetti and serve with plenty of parmesan.The Cake CaseEvil purple minion jelly cupsGrape jelly, cream and banana. PX-41 turned the minions purpleHow to make it2 packets of grape jelly crystals150ml thickened cream2 bananasMake up the jelly as the packet says and pour into clear cups.Chill until set.Whip the cream and swirl on top.Add two banana slices to each like goggles.Gru's jelly tartsBerry jam tarts from Gru's jams and jellies lineHow to make it2 sheets of shortcrust pastry300g mixed berries150g caster sugar1 lemonSimmer the berries with sugar and a squeeze of lemon until jammy, then cool.Cut the pastry into rounds and press into a patty tin.Fill with the jam.Bake at 190°C until the pastry is golden.Cups and ShakesMinion banana caramel smoothieFrozen banana, vanilla yoghurt, milk and dates, blended thickHow to make it3 ripe bananas500ml full cream milk200g vanilla yoghurt4 medjool dates1 pinch ground cinnamon4 tbsp caramel saucePeel, slice and freeze the bananas.Freeze.Blend the bananas with milk, yoghurt, pitted dates and cinnamon until thick.Drizzle caramel inside four glasses, pour in the smoothie and top with a banana slice.
